footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Western Midstream: after $31.5M attributable to noncontrolling interests. No per-share figures were reported for these years.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 6.6% to $3.8B in 2025. Gross margin was 94.6%, versus 95.2% a year earlier, and operating income fell 18.7% to $1.6B, a 41.7% margin.
Net income fell 24.9% to $1.2B, or $0.00 per share. Operating cash flow was $2.2B and free cash flow $1.5B, versus $1.3B; Western Midstream returned $1.4B through dividends.
sources: Western Midstream Partners, LP Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
